title: Doc: HOWTO.md mkp11k.c snippet has unchecked fread return value
description: The mkp11k.c example code in HOWTO.md section 4.2 contains: fread(der, 1, (size_t)dlen, f) without checking the return value. If the read is short (truncated file, I/O error), the code silently proceeds with partial data, producing a corrupt keystore. Fix: update the snippet to check fread's return value against dlen and handle the error. This is example code, but users copy it verbatim; unchecked return values in security-relevant sample code are a known source of real-world vulnerabilities.
